commands.resume: PILOT_FREEZE_SHA256=<externally-reviewed-digest> AZLITE_KALAH_V1_TABLEBASE=.tmp/broader-opening-coverage/kalah_v1_21.kvtb systemd-run --user --scope --quiet --property=CPUQuota=1800% --property=CPUWeight=100 --property=MemoryMax=38654705664 --property=AllowedCPUs=14-31 --nice=19 -- taskset -c 14-31 /home/alex/azlite-venv/bin/python -m ml.alphazero_lite.broader_opening_coverage_pilot run --freeze docs/data/broader-opening-coverage-pilot/freeze.json --expected-freeze-sha256 "$PILOT_FREEZE_SHA256" --checkpoint-dir docs/data/broader-opening-coverage-pilot/pairs --resume; preserve all existing checkpoints and attempts, and retain the frozen resource/concurrency settings.

decision_rule: For the 62 matchable openings only, propose a larger data-generation run only if treatment yield is at least 1.15 times control yield under both canonical-state and production kalah_v3 float32 identities. Zero control yield or unreconciled CPU/attempt accounting is inconclusive. The 24-active-stone unmatched control cannot contribute >32-stone positions; the 33-active-stone unmatched control could, and is outside this 62-opening estimand.
design: 62 one-to-one matched public openings in each arm; one P-vs-P seat-swapped pair per arm and opening; identical seed within matched pair; 124 pairs/248 games; retain designated-P rows only.

exclusion.coverage_rule: For each identity scheme independently, remove any retained designated-P row whose identity appears among the union of all 124 supplied control and treatment opening positions before distinct-above-32 counting.
exclusion.published_inventory_scope: verified #556-#560 only; report overlap/novelty separately and do not treat this inventory as a full historical exclusion census

matching.rule: Visit controls in #580 manifest order. For each control, choose the eligible public-pool row with the lowest opening_index, then canonical identity, that exactly matches prefix length, active stones, and current_player. Exclude any candidate whose canonical or production kalah_v3 float32 identity appears among controls. Consume each treatment opening at most once under both identity schemes. No criteria are relaxed.

metric.cpu_denominator: sum of pair CPU including evaluator/model setup and reaped native-probe CPU; capped/incomplete games contribute CPU and zero retained rows
metric.name: distinct retained designated-P positions with more than 32 active stones per CPU-hour
metric.supplied_opening_exclusion: exclude union of all supplied openings under the identity being counted, before distinct counts

resume_contract: Reuse the validated v2 pair-owned warmed probe worker and atomic checkpoint/attempt reconciliation. Resume validates existing commits and attempt records, skips verified pairs, preserves dispatch/start evidence, and stops on unreconciled started attempts.
runtime_policy: Artifact sidecars: PUCT/exact-root hybrid, exact-root threshold 16, final-score-margin objective, highest legal prior then lowest move-index tie rule, exact-leaf solving disabled.
